reddit.title: Improving the Audio Experience in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the music transitions in Provincia! No more jarring cuts between day, night, and combat music. Instead, enjoy a seamless listening experience with a smooth crossfade that enhances the atmosphere of your colony. Check out the details in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

steam.title: Audio Enhancements in Provincia
steam.body: We've made some exciting updates to the audio in Provincia! The music now transitions smoothly between different states—day, night, and combat—thanks to our new crossfade system. This means a more immersive experience as you build and manage your colony.
